messages.content: Why are puddles gone much faster on a sunny afternoon than on a cloudy one?
The sun dries them faster. Because sunshine warms the water, and warm water evaporates into the air more quickly than cool water.
Why does a cut apple turn brown if you leave it out?
The cut surface reacts with the air. Because oxygen in the air reacts with substances inside the apple once the skin is broken, and that turns the flesh brown.
Our water tank holds 1,000 litres and the family uses 250 litres a day. If it is full on Monday morning and no water comes in, when does it run out?
It runs out at the end of Thursday. Because 1,000 divided by 250 is 4, so the water lasts four days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Two friends stand 6 km apart and walk towards each other, each at 3 km an hour. When do they meet?
They meet after 1 hour. Because together they close the gap by 3 + 3 = 6 km every hour, and the gap is exactly 6 km.
Why does a metal bench feel colder than a wooden bench on a winter morning?
The metal feels colder to your hand. Because metal pulls heat out of your skin faster than wood does, even though both benches are the same temperature.
Why do rooms feel warmer when many people are inside?
Each person gives off heat. Because our bodies make warmth all the time, and in a closed room it adds up with nowhere to go.
Why should you wait for everyone to be served before you start eating at a family meal?
It shows respect for the others. Because starting alone can seem greedy and leaves people feeling left out, while waiting makes the meal a shared event.
Why do some people go quiet when they are angry?
They are trying to avoid saying something they will regret. Because silence gives time to cool down, and some people feel safer thinking before they speak.
If it starts to rain while you are at the park, what is the sensible thing to do?
Find a shelter and wait there. Because getting soaked can make you cold, and a covered spot keeps you dry until the rain eases or someone comes to fetch you.
All birds have feathers. A penguin is a bird. Does a penguin have feathers?
Yes, it does. Because the rule says every bird has feathers, so anything that is a bird must have them too.
What makes a ruler good for drawing a straight line?
Its edge guides the pencil. Because the edge is straight and stays firm, the pencil follows it instead of wobbling.
Why does an iron gate rust but a gold ring does not?
Iron is easily changed by the weather and gold is not. Because iron slowly reacts with water and air to make rust, while gold hardly reacts with anything, the ring stays shiny.
Why does a nail left near the sea rust faster than one kept far inland?
Salt in the air speeds up rusting. Because salt dissolves in the thin film of damp on the metal and helps the rusting change happen more quickly, the iron wears away sooner.
Why are people so curious about a closed gift box?
A closed box hides something we want to know. Because the mind likes to fill in missing knowledge and the box hides the answer, the wish to find out grows stronger.
Why do goalkeepers wear gloves?
Goalkeepers wear gloves for grip and protection. Because the rough surface of the glove helps hold a slippery ball and the padding softens the hit, saves are easier and less painful.
Why does a house with thick walls stay cooler in summer?
Thick walls slow the heat coming in from outside. Because the heat from the sun takes a long time to travel through the wall to the inside, the rooms stay comfortable well into the afternoon.
Why do honest people try to tell the truth even when a lie would be easier?

Honest people choose the truth to avoid the trouble that lies bring. Because a lie usually needs more lies to support it, and trust is hard to win back after it is lost, honesty saves trouble in the long run.
Why does blowing across the top of an empty bottle make a humming sound?

The hum comes from the air inside the bottle. Because the stream of air across the opening makes the air in the bottle vibrate, and the size of the bottle decides which note is loudest, we hear a steady tone.
Why do builders let concrete set for days before putting weight on it?
Concrete needs time to harden. Because the chemical reaction inside it works slowly, loading it too early could crack or weaken it.
Why do children sometimes get cranky when they are hungry or sleepy?
A tired or hungry body has less patience. Because the brain depends on rest and fuel to manage feelings, small annoyances turn into big upsets.
